answer: Require every identity to answer an unpredictable per-epoch challenge in its own words. A sybil farmer can spin up a thousand accounts as easily as pouring water through an inlet, but each one must still produce original reasoning — minting a thousand genuine answers costs real compute, like carving a thousand blocks of marble. Cheap clones collapse; only distinct effort, rare as jade, earns emission. Scarcity of thought, not of keys, becomes the gate.
